error.message: model tree is empty
the root element must be a sequence, a phase, a wiggle match or a deposition sequence
every model element needs an id
model element id 'dup' appears more than once (a tree cannot revisit a node)
unknown element_type 'trench' on element 'x'
a boundary cannot contain other elements (element 'b0')
a wiggle match holds dates and nothing else (element 'w') -- its members are separated by measured gaps, so there is no position in it for a phase or a boundary
the wiggle match 'Rings' has no dates in it; a series of gaps with nothing measured at them says nothing about the calendar
a deposition sequence holds dates and undated levels only (element 'd' contains a phase)
the deposition sequence 'd' has no dates in it; deposition cannot be modelled against depth with nothing measured at any level
the deposition sequence 'Core' has one level in it; a deposition rate is a statement about the interval between two, so a single level has nothing to model
the undated level 'Lev' has a date attached to it. It exists to report an age where nothing was dated; a level with a measurement is an ordinary date at that depth
the undated level 'l' has no depth. A level with no depth has no place in a deposition model and no age to report
a boundary cannot sit directly inside a phase (element 'p') -- a phase is unordered, so there is no position for a transition to mark. Put the boundary in a sequence.
a hiatus must sit between two boundaries (element 'h') -- it marks a gap between the end of one group and the start of the next
element 'p' has taq_age_bp (1500.5) greater than tpq_age_bp (1000.0); the valid range would be empty
sample 'A1' is not assigned to any model element
sample 'A1' references unknown model element 'nope'
sample 'A1' is attached to a boundary; dates belong to a phase, a wiggle match or a deposition sequence
sample 'a1' references unknown model element 'zz'
the wiggle match 'Rings' has dates with no gap recorded (B3, Z1). A wiggle match IS the series of gaps: without one, a date says no more than it would on its own
the wiggle match 'Rings' has two dates at the same gap. Two samples from the same ring are one event measured twice, not two members of a series
sample 'A1' has a negative gap uncertainty
the wiggle match 'Rings' names a reference sample that is not one of its members
the wiggle match 'Rings' has dates carrying an inbuilt-age allowance (A1), which it cannot apply: its members are rings of one series at measured gaps. Remove the allowance from those dates

the wiggle match 'Rings' has dates carrying an outlier model (A0, A1), which it cannot apply. Its gaps are asserted, so there is nothing for a date to be an outlier from -- a member that does not belong shows up in the agreement index instead. Turn the outlier setting off on those dates, or model them outside the series
the deposition sequence 'Core' has dates with no depth (A1). Depth is the axis the deposition model runs along, so a date without one cannot take part in it
the deposition sequence 'Core' has two levels at the same depth. The model prices the interval between successive depths, and a zero interval has no rate
the deposition sequence 'Core' has a rigidity of -1.5. k is events per unit depth and must be positive
the deposition sequence 'Core' has an empty range for its rigidity: log_k_min is not below log_k_max
